## Clinical Details

Right breast core biopsy from a 67-year-old woman presenting with a palpable upper-outer quadrant mass and mammographic spiculation (BI-RADS 4c). Specimen submitted for histological assessment and a full immunohistochemical receptor panel to guide oncological management.

| Antibody | Result | Intensity | % Cells |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Estrogen Receptor (ER) | Positive | Strong | 95% |
| Progesterone Receptor (PR) | Positive | Moderate | 70% |
| HER2/neu | Negative | Weak (1+) | 10% |
| Ki-67 | Elevated | - | 22% |
| E-cadherin | Retained | Strong | 90% |

## Diagnosis

- **Histology:** Invasive ductal carcinoma, no special type (NST), Grade 2.
- **Receptor status:** ER positive, PR positive, HER2 negative (luminal B-like).
- **Recommendation:** Discuss at multidisciplinary team meeting; consider endocrine therapy.
